profile.name: 热释电测量后端
profile.description: 用于热释电实验的非物理软件组件，负责协调 Lake Shore 350 温度控制器与 Keithley 6517B 的连接和初始配置，执行起始温度稳定、温度斜坡控制，并读取温度与电流测量数据，同时为图形界面提供日志、输入区和曲线显示等支持。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for pyroelectric experiments. It coordinates connection and initial configuration of a Lake Shore 350 temperature controller and a Keithley 6517B, performs start-temperature stabilization and temperature ramp control, acquires temperature and current readings, and supports GUI functions such as logging, input panels, and graph display.

registry.name: Pyroelectric Measurement
registry.description: Pyroelectric Measurement Backend是一款表征设备，主要功能包括关闭、初始化、启动、扫描、日志记录、测量。支持Signal, Slot, create console frame等操作。
